rationale: Ayush is building AI-powered fintech infrastructure—specifically real-time voice transformation and instant payment systems—while Venkata leads financial services strategy at UBS. Ayush's work scaling Khalti to Nepal's largest digital wallet and his current focus on AI-powered products for financial services aligns directly with enterprise fintech priorities, making this a natural conversation between a builder with proven fintech scaling experience and a financial services leader who evaluates emerging technologies.
intro_message: Venkata, meet Ayush Ojha — he's built and scaled fintech products (Khalti, now building real-time AI voice and payment infrastructure), and your financial services leadership at UBS could offer valuable perspective on his enterprise fintech trajectory.
